race.comment: HELLISH LEE (6) looks a solid chance with a win already on the board this campaign, having scored at Manangatang before covering ground and failing to quicken when seventh at Hamilton. That latest run was not a complete knock, and Linda Meech adds confidence that she can be ridden to show her best. SILVER SNOW (3) brings the cleanest recent form, winning a maiden at Cranbourne then missing by just under a length at Tatura, so he is the obvious danger if the quick back-up is handled. RICKY RUNS (5) resumes after eight months off with two trials behind him and enough past good-track form to be competitive, though he has to return ready after ending last campaign with midfield finishes. PENSATORE (4) was charging late when third in a BM62 at Moe and now gets a more suitable class scenario third-up, with his lack of a win at around 1514m the main reason he profiles slightly more as a place-to-win hope than a clear top pick.
